name: KIC 5653970
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 6.7 solar radii and 1.51 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5653970 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 6.6962 +/- 0.1144

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5653970 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.5104 +/- 0.0572

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5653970 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4880.9253 +/- 46.4583

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 5653970 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.9672 +/- 0.0039

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the colour routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.51 solar masses and 6.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,881 K at its surface.
